t: Told to look up as part of the argument
a: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
p: A-lam taraw kayfa khalaqa-llāhu sabʿa samāwātin ṭibāqā, wa jaʿala-l-qamara fīhinna nūran wa jaʿala-sh-shamsa sirājā.
m: Do you not consider how Allāh has created seven heavens in layers And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
